hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.json) npx biome check --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac; }

input=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; [ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- packages scripts .github biome.json vitest.config.ts 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; if out=$(npm run verify:quick --silent 2>&1); then exit 0; else printf 'verify:quick failed — fix before finishing:\n%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -40)" >&2; exit 2; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&| ])flyctl +(deploy|machines? +(destroy|kill)|volumes? +destroy)|git +push +[^;&|]*(--force|-f( |$)|--force-with-lease|--no-verify)'; then jq -n --arg r "Blocked by .claude/settings.json: deploys go through CI (push to main) and scripts/deploy-missions.sh; force-pushes, --no-verify pushes and machine/volume destruction are operator-only actions." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'; fi
